value.name: compares draft versions
value.description: Asha lays out the Tuesday filing beside her unfinished Monday draft and notices the changes between them.
evidence: set the Tuesday filing alongside the version she had left half-finished on Monday night
The differences were not large, which was worse; whole paragraphs of her own language had been kept

value.name: realizes filing attribution risk
value.description: She understands that if she submits the filing as her own, no one will know it was altered, but if she objects the associate will be blamed in the record.
evidence: she walked into court Monday and read the filing as her own work, no one would ever know it had not been; if she said otherwise, the associate's name would be the one in the record

value.name: delays decision
value.description: Asha leaves both windows open and forces herself to reread the softened paragraph before deciding what to do.
evidence: She sat with both of them open on the table, the kitchen quiet around her, and made herself read the softened paragraph a third time before she let herself decide anything

value.name: rewrites paragraph in own voice
value.description: Asha opens a blank document and starts retyping the softened paragraph in language she considers truly her own.
evidence: Asha opened a blank document beside the Tuesday filing and began retyping the softened paragraph in her own language
the way she would have written it Monday night if Monday night had belonged to her

value.name: tests revised motion for seams
value.description: She works carefully through the rewrite, checking whether it can be inserted into the motion without revealing the changes.
evidence: She worked slowly, testing each clause against the record, watching whether her version could be slid back into the motion without leaving the seams visible

value.name: considers using associate's certification
value.description: Asha wonders whether the associate's certification stamp can cover work that is now substantively hers again.
evidence: whether, in other words, the associate's certification stamp could be made to cover work that was now substantively hers again

value.name: receives phone notification
value.description: Before finishing the second sentence, Asha's phone lights up, interrupting her work.
evidence: She was halfway through the second sentence when her phone lit on
